rules: RULING 68-72,83; printed MASTER pages. Source JSON remains unchanged.

Lightning Rod.scope: Single-target Electric redirection from any active participant, Electric damage immunity and a first-hit Special +1 ability channel. Competing redirectors require a logged GM choice.

Storm Drain.scope: Single-target Water redirection from any active participant, Water damage immunity and a first-hit Special +1 ability channel. Competing redirectors require a logged GM choice.

Stalwart.scope: Bypass move/ability target redirection, including lures, attractors and support reflection. Cover is a separate maneuver.

Propeller Tail.scope: Bypass move/ability target redirection, including lures, attractors and support reflection. Cover is a separate maneuver.

Magic Bounce.scope: Reflect executable foe Support effects aimed at the holder or its side, once, without extra actions/accuracy. Preserve original resource payer and reflected effect source. Unimplemented Support effects still require adjudication; manual field records retain reflected scope.

Good As Gold.scope: Block foe and ally Support effects on the holder. Self effects and effects targeting a battlefield side remain distinct.

Suction Cups.scope: Prevent forced switches originating from foes. Outside-battle capture/flavor effects remain manual.

Emergency Exit.scope: Crossing to half HP or less queues a controlled owner/GM reserve choice, ignoring Block. Switcher icon uses inherited initiative and remaining actions. One completed switcher effect per affected trainer per round; no reserve needs an explicit GM outcome.

Wimp Out.scope: Crossing to half HP or less queues a controlled owner/GM reserve choice, ignoring Block. Switcher icon uses inherited initiative and remaining actions. One completed switcher effect per affected trainer per round; no reserve needs an explicit GM outcome.

Prankster.scope: Add Reaction 1 to Support moves. Retain higher printed early reaction priority; conflicting Late Reaction requires a recorded printed/ability timing ruling. Unsupported move effects and charge reaction exceptions remain explicit.

Gale Wings.scope: Add Reaction 1 to Flying moves without imposing a video-game full-HP requirement. Retain higher printed early priority; conflicting Late Reaction needs a recorded timing ruling. Charge reactions still need adjudication.

Dazzling.scope: Prevent foe reaction moves targeting this holder, including typed ability-granted reactions. Maneuvers Evasion/Clash remain available.

Queenly Majesty.scope: Prevent foe reaction moves targeting this holder. Maneuvers Evasion/Clash remain available.

Armor Tail.scope: Prevent Physical/Special reaction-tagged moves from targeting the user or allies in its confirmed range, including late and ability-granted tags. Support moves and maneuvers remain distinct.

Stall.scope: Always sort last in initiative, including Trick Room and remaining-order changes; completed turns are not replayed.

Follow Me.scope: One-round single-target lure. Redirect eligible foe moves, including unresolved incoming attacks before damage commits; multiple competing sources require a recorded GM choice.

Rage Powder.scope: One-round single-target lure for foe Physical/Special moves; Support moves are not attracted. Grass-type and Overcoat powder immunity follow the reviewed manual. No unsupported held-item exception is invented.

Spotlight.scope: One-round single-target lure. Redirect eligible foe moves, including unresolved incoming attacks before damage commits; multiple competing sources require a recorded GM choice.

Magic Coat.scope: Self-targeted Reaction 4; no stated duration, so a recorded GM duration choice is required. Reflect incoming foe Support effects on the user or its side once; resource payer and reflected source stay distinct. Unsupported effects remain adjudicated.

Air Cutter.scope: All-foe shared damage, High Critical, Wind and Cutter tags; no post-damage added effect. Eligible for Gale Wings Reaction 1.

Ally Switch.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks. Reaction 3 restores its action cost and grants the incoming ally a response to the pending attack.

Roar.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

Whirlwind.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

Dragon Tail.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

Circle Throw.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

U-Turn.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

Volt Switch.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

Baton Pass.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks. Transfer supported positive move attribute channels and lock self-boosts until recipient faints/end of encounter.

Teleport.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

Parting Shot.scope: Reviewed switcher effect: conscious same-trainer/owner/side reserve, inherited slot/initiative/remaining actions, one completed switcher effect per trainer per round; explicit no-reserve outcome, ownership and retry checks.

Shed Tail.scope: Requires Substitute/decoy state. No substitute switch is silently approximated.
